Fenugreek [is prepared] in broth, oil and wine.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tor. or fenum; G.-V. Fænum.

recipes.title: Vihreät pavut ja kikherneet kuminalla
recipes.originalTitle: Green string beans and chick-peas (PHASEOLI VIRIDES ET CICER)
recipes.description: Pavut tai kikherneet tarjotaan suolan, kuminan, öljyn ja tilkan viiniä kanssa.
ingredients: 2 tlk (à 400 g) kikherneitä valutettuina tai 500 g vihreitä papuja
instructions: Lämmitä kikherneet tai keitä pavut.
Mausta suolalla, kuminalla, öljyllä ja tilkalla viiniä.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Are served with salt, cumin, oil, and a little pure wine.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tor. Faseolus, the bean with a long, sabre-like pod; a phasel, kidney bean, when ripened.

recipes.title: Pavut ja kikherneet viinikastikkeessa
recipes.description: Pavut tai kikherneet keitetään viinikastikkeessa ja maustetaan pippurilla.
instructions: Hauduta pavut tai kikherneet viinin ja kalakastikkeen seoksessa.
Mausta pippurilla.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
[beans or chick-peas] are cooked in a wine sauce and seasoned with pepper [1].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Dann. and Goll.: "roasted" beans.

recipes.title: Papusalaatti kananmunilla ja fenkolilla
recipes.description: Keitetyt pavut tarjotaan salaattina kovaksi keitettyjen munien, tuoreen fenkolin, pippurin, garumin ja keitetyn viinin kanssa.
instructions: Asettele pavut, munat ja fenkoli vadille.
Sekoita pippuri, kalakastike, siirappi, suola ja öljy ja kaada päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
And cook the beans, in a rich manner, remove the seeds and serve [as a salad [2]], with hard eggs, green fennel, pepper, broth, a little reduced wine and a little salt, or serve them in simpler ways, as you may see fit.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] The original continues with the preceding formula. [2] For a salad we would add finely chopped onion, pepper, and some lemon juice. The purpose of removing the seeds is obscure. G.-V. reads semine cum ovis; Tac. semie; Hum. s. cum lobis. The passage may mean to sprinkle (sow) with hard boiled (and finely chopped) eggs, which is often done on a salad and other dishes.

recipes.title: Keitetty strutsi taatelikastikkeessa
recipes.description: Strutsi (tai naudanliha) keitetään pippuria, minttua, kuminaa, purjoa, sellerinsiementä, taateleita, hunajaa, etikkaa ja makeaa viiniä sisältävässä liemessä, joka suurustetaan kastikkeeksi.
instructions: Keitä liha vedessä mausteiden, taatelien, hunajan, etikan, viinin, kalakastikkeen ja öljyn kanssa mureaksi. Lisää halutessasi valkosipuli.
Nosta liha pois, siivilöi liemi ja suurusta kastikkeeksi.
Paloittele liha kastikkeeseen ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
[a stock in which to cook ostrich] pepper, mint, cumin, leeks [1], celery seed, dates, honey, vinegar, raisin wine, broth, a little oil. Boil this in the stock kettle [with the ostrich, remove the bird when done, strain the liquid] thicken with roux. [to this sauce] add the ostrich meat cut in convenient pieces, sprinkle with pepper. If you wish it more seasoned or tasty, add garlic [during coction].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] G.-V. Cuminum; Tor. C., porrum, which is more likely.

recipes.title: Strutsi timjami-sinappikastikkeessa
recipes.description: Keitetylle strutsille kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, timjamista, kyntelistä, hunajasta, sinapista, etikasta, garumista ja öljystä.
instructions: Keitä liha vedessä mureaksi.
Survo mausteet ja sekoita hunajaan, sinappiin, etikkaan, kalakastikkeeseen ja öljyyn.
Tarjoa kastike viipaloidun lihan kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, thyme, also satury, honey, mustard, vinegar, broth and oil.

Crane, duck, partridge, dove, wood pigeon, squab, and divers birds in grue vel anate perdice turture palumbo columbo et diversis avibus

recipes.title: Ankka oregano-korianteriliemessä
recipes.description: Ankka keitetään puolikypsäksi tillivedessä ja haudutetaan sitten öljyssä ja garumissa oregano-korianterinipun kanssa; kastike kuminasta, asafetidasta, ruudasta ja hunajasta.
instructions: Keitä ankkaa suolatussa vedessä tillin kanssa puolikypsäksi.
Siirrä ankka kattilaan öljyn, kalakastikkeen ja yrttinipun kanssa ja hauduta lähes kypsäksi. Lisää siirappi väriksi.
Survo mausteet viinin ja hunajan kanssa, lisää haudutuslientä ja etikkaa, kuumenna ja suurusta.
Siivilöi kastike ankan päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Wash [the fowl] and dress it nicely [1] put in a stew pot, add water, salt and dill, parboil [2] so as to have them half done, until the meat is hard, remove them, put them in a sauce pan [to be finished by braising] with oil, broth, a bunch of origany and coriander; when nearly done, add a little reduced must, to give it color. Meanwhile crush pepper, lovage, cumin, coriander, laser root, rue [moistened with] reduced wine and some honey, add some of the fowl broth [3] to it and vinegar to taste; empty [the sauce] into a sauce pan, heat, bind with roux, and [strain] the sauce over the fowl in an entrée dish.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Lavas et ornas, i.e., singe, empty carcass of intestines, truss or bind it to keep its shape during coction, and, usually, lard it with either strips or slices of fat pork and stuff the carcass with greens, celery leaves, etc. [2] Dimidia coctura decoques. Apicius here pursues the right course for the removable of any disagreeable taste often adhering to aquatic fowl, feeding on fish or food found in the water, by parboiling the meat. Cf. {Rx} No. 214. [3] Again, as so often: ius de suo sibi; here the liquor of the braising pan, for stock in which the fowl is parboiled cannot be used for reasons set forth in Note 2.

recipes.title: Ankka luumukastikkeessa
recipes.originalTitle: Another way of cooking crane, duck or chicken (ALITER IN GRUE [VEL] IN ANATE VEL IN PULLO)
recipes.description: Keitetylle ankalle tai kanalle kastike pippurista, salottisipulista, lipstikasta, kuminasta, sellerinsiemenestä, luumuista, rypälemehusta, etikasta, garumista ja öljystä.
instructions: Keitä lintu suolavedessä kypsäksi.
Keitä kastikkeen aineet kokoon ja soseuta.
Tarjoa kastike linnun kanssa. (Alkuperäinen ohje kurjelle neuvoo vetämään pään irti niin, että kovat jänteet seuraavat mukana.)
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, shallots, lovage, cumin, celery seed, prunes or damascus plums stones removed, fresh must, vinegar [1] broth, reduced must and oil. Boil the crane; while cooking it take care that its head is not touched by the water but that it remains without. When the crane is done, wrap it in a hot towel, and pull the head off so that the sinews follow in a manner that the meat and the bones remain; for one cannot enjoy the hard sinews [2].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Dann. mead. [2] Remarkable ingenuity! Try this on your turkey legs. Danneil is of the opinion that the head and its feathers were to be saved for decorative purposes, in style during the middle ages when game bird patties were decorated with the fowl's plumage, a custom which survived to Danneil's time (ca. 1900). But this is not likely to be the case here, for it would be a simple matter to skin the bird before cooking it in order to save the plumage for the taxidermist.

recipes.title: Ankka nauriiden kanssa
recipes.originalTitle: Crane or duck with turnips (GRUEM VEL ANATEM EX RAPIS)
recipes.description: Puolikypsä ankka haudutetaan öljyssä ja garumissa purjo-korianterinipun ja naurispalojen kanssa; kastike pippurista, kuminasta, korianterista ja asafetidasta.
instructions: Keitä ankka puolikypsäksi suolatussa vedessä tillin kanssa.
Keitä nauriit erikseen, purista ja paloittele.
Hauduta ankka öljyssä ja kalakastikkeessa purjon ja korianterin kanssa nauriit päällä. Lisää siirappi väriksi.
Survo mausteet etikan ja haudutusliemen kanssa, kuumenna, suurusta ja kaada ankan päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Take out [remove entrails, [2]] clean wash and dress [the bird] and parboil [2] it in water with salt and dill. Next prepare turnips and cook them in water which is to be squeezed out [3]. Take them out of the pot and wash them again [4]. And put into a sauce pan the duck with oil, broth, a bunch of leeks and coriander; the turnips cut into small pieces; these put on top of the [duck] in order to finish cooking. When half done, to give it color, add reduced must. The sauce is prepared separately: pepper, cumin, coriander, laser root moistened with vinegar and diluted with its own broth [of the fowl]; bring this to a boiling point, thicken with roux. [in a deep dish arrange the duck] on top of the turnips [strain the sauce over it] sprinkle with pepper and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Duck and Turnips, a dish much esteemed on the Continent today. Only few prepare it correctly as does Old Apicius; hence it is not popular with the multitude. [2] Tac., Tor. excipies; Hum. legendum: ex rapis. [3] G.-V. ut exbromari possint; Tor. expromi; Hum. expromari; all of which does not mean anything. To cook the turnips so that they can be squeezed out (exprimo, from ex and premo) is the proper thing to do from a culinary standpoint. [4] The turnips are cooked half, the water removed, and finished with the duck, as prescribed by Apicius. It is really admirable to see how he handles these food materials in order to remove any disagreeable flavor, which may be the case both with the turnips (the small white variety) and the duck. Such careful treatment is little known nowadays even in the best kitchens. Cf. Note 2 to {Rx} No. 212.

recipes.title: Keitetty ankka pähkinä-taatelikastikkeessa
recipes.originalTitle: Another [sauce for] crane or duck (ALITER IN GRUEM VEL ANATEM ELIXAM)
recipes.description: Kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, kuminasta, korianterista, mintusta, oreganosta, pinjansiemenistä, taateleista, hunajasta, sinapista ja viinistä.
instructions: Keitä ankka suolavedessä kypsäksi.
Survo mausteet, pinjansiemenet ja taatelit ja sekoita loput aineet kastikkeeksi.
Tarjoa kastike paloitellun ankan kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, cumin, dry coriander, mint, origany, pine nuts, dates, broth, oil, honey, mustard and wine [1].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Supposedly the ingredients for a sauce in which the parboiled fowl is braised and served.

recipes.title: Paahdettu ankka kurpitsan ja sisälmysten kanssa
recipes.originalTitle: Roast crane or duck (ALITER GRUEM VEL ANATEM ASSAM)
recipes.description: Paahdetulle ankalle kastike pippurista, lipstikasta ja oreganosta, hunajasta ja etikasta; kastikkeessa kypsennetään kurpitsapaloja ja kanan sisälmyksiä.
instructions: Paahda ankka uunissa 180 asteessa noin 1,5 tuntia.
Keitä kastikkeen aineet, suurusta ja siivilöi.
Kypsennä kurpitsapalat ja sisälmykset kastikkeessa.
Tarjoa ankka kastikkeen ja kurpitsan kanssa, päälle hienoa pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
POUR OVER [the roast bird] THIS GRAVY: CRUSH PEPPER, LOVAGE, ORIGANY WITH BROTH, HONEY, A LITTLE VINEGAR AND OIL; BOIL IT WELL, THICKEN WITH ROUX [strain] IN THIS SAUCE PLACE SMALL PIECES OF PARBOILED PUMPKIN OR COLOCASIUM [1] SO THAT THEY ARE FINISHED IN THE SAUCE; ALSO COOK WITH IT CHICKEN FEET AND GIBLETS (all of which) SERVE IN A CHAFING DISH, SPRINKLE WITH FINE PEPPER AND SERVE.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Cf. {Rx} Nos. 74, 216, 244, 322.

recipes.title: Ankka rucola-taatelikastikkeessa
recipes.originalTitle: Boiled crane or duck in another manner (ALITER IN GRUE VEL ANATE ELIXA)
recipes.description: Kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, sellerinsiemenestä, rucolasta tai korianterista, mintusta, taateleista, hunajasta, etikasta, garumista, rypälesiirapista ja sinapista.
instructions: Keitä tai hauduta ankka kypsäksi.
Survo kastikkeen aineet ja tarjoa ankan kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, celery seed, rocket, or coriander, mint, dates, honey, vinegar, broth, reduced must and mustard. Likewise used for fowl roast [braised] in the pot.

Ways to prepare partridge, heath-cock or woodcock, and boiled turtle-dove in perdice et attagena et in turture elixis

recipes.title: Peltopyy myrtti-rusinakastikkeessa
recipes.description: Peltopyy haudutetaan omassa liemessään; kylmä kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, sellerinsiemenestä, mintusta, myrttimarjoista, rusinoista, hunajasta, viinistä ja etikasta.
instructions: Hauduta linnut öljyssä ja vedessä kannen alla mureiksi valellen.
Survo kastikkeen aineet ja tarjoa kylmänä lintujen kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, celery seed, mint, myrtle berries, also raisins, honey [1] wine, vinegar, broth, and oil. Use it cold [2] the partridge is scalded with its feathers, and while wet the feathers are taken off; [the hair singed] it is then cooked in its own juice [braised] and when done will not be hard if care is taken [to baste it]. Should it remain hard [if it is old] you must continue to cook it until it is tender.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Honey wanting in Tor. [2] G.-V. Aliter. This is one formula.

recipes.title: Kastike peltopyylle ja kyyhkyselle
recipes.originalTitle: [sauce] for partridge, heath-cock and turtle-dove (IN PERDICE ET ATTAGENA ET IN TURTURE)
recipes.description: Lämmin kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, mintusta, ruudansiemenistä, garumista, viinistä ja öljystä.
instructions: Paahda tai hauduta linnut.
Lämmitä kastikkeen aineet ja tarjoa lintujen kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, mint, rue seed, broth, pure wine, and oil, heated.

Wood pigeons, squabs, fattened fowl, flamingo in palumbis columbis avibus in altile et in fenicoptero

recipes.title: Kastike paahdetuille linnuille
recipes.description: Pippuria, lipstikkaa, korianteria, kuminaa, salottisipulia, minttua, munankeltuaisia, taateleita, hunajaa, etikkaa, garumia, öljyä ja viiniä.
instructions: Survo kaikki aineet tasaiseksi kastikkeeksi.
Lämmitä ja tarjoa paahdetun kanan tai muun linnun kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText: For roasts: pepper, lovage, coriander, carraway, shallots, mint, yolks of egg, dates, honey, vinegar, broth, oil and wine.

recipes.title: Kastike keitetyille linnuille
recipes.description: Pippuria, kuminaa, sellerinsiementä, persiljaa, taateleita, hunajaa, etikkaa, viiniä, öljyä ja sinappia.
instructions: Survo kaikki aineet kastikkeeksi.
Tarjoa keitetyn kanan tai muun linnun kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
To the boiled fowl add [1] pepper, carraway, celery seed, parsley, condiments, mortaria [2] dates, honey, vinegar, wine, oil and mustard.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tor. wanting in other texts. [2] Mortaria: herbs, spices, things pounded in the "mortar." Cf. {Rx} No. 38.

recipes.title: Pinjansiemen-taatelikastike linnuille
recipes.description: Pippuria, lipstikkaa, persiljaa, sellerinsiementä, ruutaa, pinjansiemeniä, taateleita, hunajaa, etikkaa, garumia, sinappia ja öljyä.
instructions: Survo kaikki aineet kastikkeeksi.
Tarjoa linnun kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText: Pepper, lovage, parsley, celery seed, rue, pine nuts, dates, honey, vinegar, broth, mustard and a little oil.

recipes.title: Kyyhkynen asafetida-viinikastikkeessa
recipes.description: Pippuria, lipstikkaa ja asafetidaa viinin ja garumin kanssa; kastike kaadetaan kyyhkysen päälle ja ripotellaan pippurilla.
instructions: Survo mausteet, lisää viini ja kalakastike maun mukaan ja lämmitä.
Kaada kastike lintujen päälle ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, laser, wine [1] moistened with broth. Add wine and broth to taste. Mask the wood pigeon or squab with it. Sprinkle with pepper [2] and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tac., Tor. laserum, vinum; G.-V. l. vivum. [2] Wanting in Tor.

recipes.title: Myrttiviinikastike linnuille
recipes.originalTitle: Sauce for different birds (IUS IN DIVERSIS AVIBUS)
recipes.description: Pippuria, kuminaa, lipstikkaa, minttua, rusinoita tai luumuja, hunajaa, myrttiviiniä, etikkaa, garumia ja öljyä, vispattuna sellerin ja kyntelin kanssa.
instructions: Survo mausteet ja hedelmät, lisää hunaja, viini, etikka, kalakastike ja öljy.
Kuumenna ja vispaa sellerin ja kyntelin kanssa. Tarjoa linnun kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, dry cumin, crushed. Lovage, mint, seedless raisins or damascus plums, little honey, myrtle wine to taste, vinegar, broth, and oil. Heat and whip it well with celery and satury [1].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] For centuries sauce whips were made of dry and green twigs, the bark of which was carefully peeled off.

recipes.title: Hasselpähkinäkastike linnuille
recipes.originalTitle: Another sauce for fowl (ALITER IUS IN AVIBUS)
recipes.description: Pippuria, lipstikkaa, persiljaa, minttua ja fenkolia viinissä; paahdettuja hasselpähkinöitä tai manteleita, hunajaa, etikkaa ja garumia, lopuksi selleriä ja kissanminttua.
instructions: Survo mausteet ja yrtit viinin kanssa, lisää pähkinät, hunaja, etikka ja kalakastike.
Kuumenna öljy kattilassa ja sekoita kastike siinä. Lisää sellerinsiemenet.
Paloittele lintu ja kaada kastike päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, parsley, dry mint, fennel blossoms [1] moistened with wine; add roasted nuts from pontus [2] or almonds, a little honey, wine, vinegar, and broth to taste. Put oil in a pot, and heat and stir the sauce, adding green celery seed, cat-mint; carve the fowl and cover with the sauce [3].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Dann. Cnecus. [2] Turkish hazelnuts. [3] Tor. continuing without interruption.

recipes.title: Valkoinen pähkinäkastike keitetylle kanalle
recipes.originalTitle: White sauce for boiled fowl (IUS CANDIDUM IN AVEM ELIXAM)
recipes.description: Pippuria, lipstikkaa, kuminaa, sellerinsiementä, paahdettuja hasselpähkinöitä tai manteleita, pinjansiemeniä, hunajaa, garumia, etikkaa ja öljyä.
ingredients: 3 rkl kuorittuja manteleita tai hasselpähkinöitä paahdettuina
instructions: Survo mausteet ja pähkinät hienoksi.
Sekoita hunaja, kalakastike, etikka, öljy ja vesi tasaiseksi valkoiseksi kastikkeeksi. Tarjoa keitetyn kanan kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, lovage, cumin, celery seed, toasted nuts from pontus, or almonds, also shelled pine nuts, honey [1] a little broth, vinegar and oil.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tor. vel; List. mel.

recipes.title: Vihreä yrttikastike linnuille
recipes.originalTitle: Green sauce for fowl (IUS VIRIDE IN AVIBUS)
recipes.description: Pippuria, kuminaa, laakerinlehteä ja kaikenlaisia vihreitä yrttejä taateleiden, hunajan, etikan, viinin, garumin ja öljyn kanssa.
instructions: Survo mausteet, yrtit ja taatelit tahnaksi.
Sekoita joukkoon hunaja, etikka, viini, kalakastike ja öljy. Tarjoa kanan tai muun linnun kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText: Pepper, carraway, indian spikenard, cumin, bay leaves, all kinds of green herbs, dates, honey, vinegar, wine, little broth, and oil.

recipes.title: Hanhi valkoisessa pähkinäkastikkeessa
recipes.originalTitle: White sauce for boiled goose (IUS CANDIDUM IN ANSERE ELIXO)
recipes.description: Keitetylle hanhelle kastike pippurista, kuminasta, sellerinsiemenestä, timjamista, sipulista, asafetidasta, paahdetuista pähkinöistä, hunajasta ja etikasta.
instructions: Keitä lintu suolavedessä kypsäksi.
Survo mausteet, sipuli ja pähkinät ja sekoita hunajaan, etikkaan, kalakastikkeeseen ja öljyyn.
Tarjoa kastike viipaloidun hanhen kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Pepper, carraway, cumin, celery seed, thyme, onion, laser root, toasted nuts, honey, vinegar, broth and oil [1]

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] A "sweet-sour" white sauce with herbs and spices is often served with goose in northern Germany.

recipes.title: Riistalinnut taikinakuoressa
recipes.originalTitle: Treatment of strong smelling birds of every description (AD AVES HIRCOSAS OMNI GENERE)
recipes.description: Voimakkaan makuisille linnuille kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, timjamista, mintusta, salviasta, taateleista, hunajasta ja sinapista; linnut paistetaan jauho-öljytaikinakuoressa, joka pitää ne mehukkaina.
instructions: Sekoita jauhot, öljy ja vesi taikinaksi ja kääri linnut taikinaan.
Paista 180 asteessa noin 1 h 15 min.
Survo ja sekoita kastikkeen aineet ja tarjoa lintujen kanssa – kuori rikotaan pöydässä.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
For birds of all kinds that have a goatish [1] smell [2] pepper, lovage, thyme, dry mint, sage, dates, honey, vinegar, wine, broth, oil, reduced must, mustard. The birds will be more luscious and nutritious, and the fat preserved, if you envelop them in a dough of flour and oil and bake them in the oven [3].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Probably game birds in an advanced stage of "haut goût" (as the Germans use the antiquated French term), or "mortification" as the French cook says. Possibly also such birds as crows, black birds, buzzards, etc., and fish-feeding fowl. Moreover, it must be borne in mind that the refrigeration facilities of the ancients were not too good and that fresh goods spoiled quickly. Hence, perhaps, excessive seasoning, at least, as compared to our modern methods. List. aves piscivoras; Hum. thinks the birds to be downright spoiled: olidas, rancidas, & grave olentes. [2] Tor. Sentence wanting in other texts. [3] For birds with a goatish smell Apicius should have repeated his excellent formula in {Rx} No. 212, the method of parboiling the birds before final coction, if, indeed, one cannot dispense with such birds altogether. The above recipe does not in the least indicate how to treat smelly birds. Wrapping them in dough would vastly increase the ill-savour. As for game birds, we agree with most connoisseurs that they should have just a suspicion of "haut goût"--a condition of advanced mellowness after the rigor mortis has disappeared.

recipes.title: Ankka taateli-ruutakastikkeessa (flamingon tapaan)
recipes.description: Alkuperäisessä flamingo tai papukaija: lintu keitetään tilli-etikkavedessä, haudutetaan purjon ja korianterin kanssa ja tarjotaan kumina-minttu-taatelikastikkeessa.
instructions: Keitä ankkaa vedessä suolan, tillin ja etikan kanssa puolikypsäksi.
Hauduta kypsäksi purjon ja korianterin kanssa ja lisää siirappi väriksi.
Survo mausteet etikan ja taatelien kanssa, lisää haudutuslientä ja suurusta.
Siivilöi kastike linnun päälle ja tarjoa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Scald [1] the flamingo, wash and dress it, put it in a pot, add water, salt, dill, and a little vinegar, to be parboiled. Finish cooking with a bunch of leeks and coriander, and add some reduced must to give it color. In the mortar crush pepper, cumin, coriander, laser root, mint, rue, moisten with vinegar, add dates, and the fond of the braised bird, thicken, [strain] cover the bird with the sauce and serve. Parrot is prepared in the same manner.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Prior to removing the feathers; also singe the fine feathers and hair.

recipes.title: Paahdettu lintu seesami-taatelikastikkeessa
recipes.description: Paahdetulle linnulle kastike pippurista, lipstikasta, sellerinsiemenestä, seesamista, persiljasta, mintusta, salottisipulista, taateleista, hunajasta, viinistä ja etikasta.
instructions: Paahda lintu uunissa kypsäksi.
Survo kastikkeen aineet ja maista. Tarjoa linnun kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Roast the bird. Crush pepper, lovage, celery seed, sesam [1] parsley, mint, shallots, dates, honey, wine, broth, vinegar, oil, reduced must to taste.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tor. sesamum, defrutum; G.-V. s. frictum.

recipes.title: Keitetty hanhi kylmällä Apiciuksen kastikkeella
recipes.originalTitle: Boiled goose with cold apician sauce (ANSEREM ELIXUM EX IURE APICIANO FRIGIDO)
recipes.description: Kuuma keitetty hanhi pyyhitään puhtaaksi ja valellaan pippurin, lipstikan, korianterin, mintun ja ruudan kastikkeella.
instructions: Keitä hanhi suolavedessä kypsäksi.
Survo mausteet kalakastikkeen ja öljyn kanssa.
Pyyhi kuuma hanhi liinalla, kaada kylmä kastike päälle ja tarjoa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Crush pepper, lovage, coriander seed [1] mint, rue, moisten with broth and a moderate amount of oil. Take the cooked goose out of the pot and while hot wipe it clean with a towel, pour the sauce over it and serve.

[for chicken] [in pullo]

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] G.-V.; Tor. (fresh) coriander, more suited for a cold sauce.

recipes.title: Tillikana (raaka kastike keitetylle kanalle)
recipes.originalTitle: Raw sauce for boiled chicken (IN PULLO ELIXO IUS CRUDUM)
recipes.description: Keitetylle kanalle raaka kastike tillinsiemenistä, kuivatusta mintusta ja asafetidasta, etikasta, viikunaviinistä, garumista, sinapista, öljystä ja rypälesiirapista.
instructions: Keitä kana suolavedessä kypsäksi.
Survo kastikkeen aineet huhmareessa ja tarjoa kanan kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Put in the mortar dill seed, dry mint, laser root, moisten with vinegar, fig wine, broth, a little mustard, oil and reduced must, and serve [1] [known as] dill chicken [2].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] This and the preceding cold dressings are more or less variations of our modern cold dressings that are used for cold dishes of all kinds, especially salads. [2] Tor. heads the following formula præparatio pulli anethi--chicken in dill sauce, which is the correct description of the above formula. Tac., G.-V. also commence the next with pullum anethatum, which is not correct, as the following recipe contains no dill.

recipes.title: Hunajakana paistettuna
recipes.description: Keitetty kana neljännetään, upotetaan hunajalla maustettuun liemeen, paistetaan ja valellaan omalla liemellään.
instructions: Keitä kana puolikypsäksi, poista nahka ja kuivaa liinalla. Paloittele neljään osaan.
Sekoita hunaja ja kalakastike pieneen määrään lientä ja anna palojen maustua liemessä.
Paista palat öljyssä kypsiksi, kaada päälle liemi ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
A little honey is mixed with broth; the cooked [parboiled] chicken is cleaned [skin taken off, sinews, etc., removed] the carcass dried with a towel, quartered, the pieces immersed in broth [2] so that the savour penetrates thoroughly. Fry the pieces [in the pan] pour over their own gravy, sprinkle with pepper, serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Hum., List. cf. Note 2 to {Rx} No. 235. [2] Marinated; but the nature of this marinade is not quite clear; a spicy marinade of wine and herbs and spices would be appropriate for certain game birds, but chicken ordinarily requires no marinade except some oil before frying. It is possible that Apicius left the cooked chicken in the broth to prevent it from drying out, which is good.

recipes.title: Parthialainen kana
recipes.description: Neljännetty kana paistetaan ja haudutetaan saviruukussa pippurin, lipstikan ja kuminan, garumin, viinin ja asafetidan kanssa.
instructions: Paista kanapalat öljyssä ruskeiksi ja laita saviruukkuun tai pataan.
Survo mausteet kalakastikkeen kanssa, lisää viini ja asafetida ja kaada kanan päälle.
Hauduta kypsäksi ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Dress the chicken carefully [2] and quarter it. Crush pepper, lovage and a little carraway [3] moistened with broth, and add wine to taste. [after frying] place the chicken in an earthen dish [4] pour the seasoning over it, add laser and wine [5] let it assimilate with the seasoning and braise the chicken to a point. When done sprinkle with pepper and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Lister is of the opinion that the pullus Parthicus is a kind of chicken that came originally from Asia, Parthia being a country of Asia, the present Persia or northern India, a chicken of small size with feathers on its feet, i.e., a bantam. [2] Pluck, singe, empty, wash, trim. The texts: a navi. Hum. hoc est, à parte posteriore ventris, qui ut navis cavus & figuræ ejus non dissimile est. Dann. takes this literally, but navo (navus) here simply means "to perform diligently." [3] Tor. casei modicum; List. carei--more likely than cheese. [4] Cumana--an earthenware casserole, excellent for that purpose. [5] G.-V. laser [et] vivum.

recipes.title: Hapan kana purjolla ja persiljalla
recipes.description: Kana kypsennetään runsaassa öljyssä, garumissa ja etikassa pippurin, persiljan ja purjonipun kanssa.
instructions: Laita kanapalat pataan öljyn, kalakastikkeen ja etikan kanssa.
Lisää pippuri, persilja ja purjo ja hauduta kannen alla kypsäksi.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
A good-sized glass of oil, a smaller glass of broth, and the smallest measure of vinegar, 6 scruples of pepper, parsley and a bunch of leeks.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

G.-V. [laseris] satis modice. These directions are very vague. If the raw chicken is quartered, fried in the oil, and then braised in the broth with a dash of vinegar, the bunch of leeks and parsley, seasoned with pepper and a little salt, we have a dish gastronomically correct. The leeks may be served as a garnish, the gravy, properly reduced and strained over the chicken which like in the previous formula is served in a casserole.

recipes.title: Numidialainen kana taateleilla ja pähkinöillä
recipes.description: Keitetty kana maustetaan asafetidalla ja pippurilla ja paistetaan; kastike kuminasta, korianterista, ruudasta, taateleista ja pähkinöistä, hunajasta ja etikasta.
instructions: Keitä kana puolikypsäksi, mausta asafetidalla ja pippurilla ja paista pannulla.
Survo mausteet, taatelit ja pähkinät ja sekoita etikkaan, hunajaan, kalakastikkeeseen, öljyyn ja liemeen.
Kiehauta, suurusta, siivilöi kanan päälle ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Prepare [1] the chicken [as usual; par-] boil it; clean it [2] seasoned with laser and pepper, and fry [in the pan; next] crush pepper, cumin, coriander seed, laser root, rue, fig dates and nuts, moistened with vinegar, honey, broth and oil to taste [3] when boiling thicken with roux [strain] pour over the chicken, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Curas. [2] Remove skin, tissues, bones, etc., cut in pieces and marinate in the pickle. [3] Immerse the chicken pieces in this sauce and braise them to a point.

recipes.title: Asafetidakana saviruukussa
recipes.description: Kana haudutetaan saviruukussa pippurin, lipstikan ja asafetidan, viinin ja garumin kanssa.
instructions: Laita kana saviruukkuun tai pataan.
Survo mausteet viinin kanssa, lisää kalakastike ja kaada kanan päälle.
Hauduta kypsäksi ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Dress the chicken carefully [1] clean, garnish [2] and place in an earthen casserole. Crush pepper, lovage, laser moistened with wine [3] add broth and wine to taste, and put this on the fire; when done serve with pepper sprinkled over.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] a navi. cf. Note 2 to {Rx} No. 237. [2] G.-V. lavabis, ornabis, with vegetables, etc. [3] G.-V. laser vivum.

recipes.title: Paahdettu kana persiljaöljyllä
recipes.description: Paahdetulle kanalle kastike asafetidasta, pippurista, öljystä, garumista ja persiljasta.
instructions: Paahda kana uunissa 200 asteessa noin tunti.
Sekoita kastikkeen aineet ja valele kanaa paahdon aikana ja tarjoillessa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
A little laser, 6 scruples of pepper, a glass of oil, a glass of broth, and a little parsley.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Paropsis, parapsis, from the Greek, a platter, dish. A most incomplete formula. It does not state whether the ingredients are to be added to the sauce or the dressing. We have an idea that the chicken is pickled in this solution before roasting and that the pickle is used in making the gravy.

recipes.title: Keitetty kana mausteisessa taatelikastikkeessa
recipes.originalTitle: Boiled chicken in its own broth (PULLUM ELIXUM EX IURE SUO)
recipes.description: Keitetty kana valellaan kastikkeella, jossa pippuria, kuminaa, timjamia, fenkolinsiemeniä, minttua, ruutaa, asafetidaa, taateleita, hunajaa, etikkaa ja öljyä.
instructions: Keitä kana kypsäksi ja kuivaa liinalla.
Survo mausteet etikan ja taatelien kanssa ja mausta hunajalla, kalakastikkeella ja öljyllä.
Kaada kastike kanan päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Crush pepper, cumin, a little thyme, fennel seed, mint, rue, laser root, moistened with vinegar, add fig dates [1] work well and make it savory with honey, vinegar, broth and oil to taste: the boiled chicken properly cleaned and dried [with the towel] is masked with this sauce [2].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Goll. cloves--cariophyllus; the originals have caryotam and careotam. [2] Apparently another cold sauce of the vinaigrette type similar to {Rx} No. 235.

recipes.title: Kana ja kurpitsa sinappikastikkeessa
recipes.originalTitle: Chicken and pumpkin (PULLUM ELIXUM CUM CUCURBITIS ELIXIS)
recipes.description: Keitetty kana ja keitetty kurpitsa edellisellä taatelikastikkeella, johon lisätään sinappia.
instructions: Keitä kana ja kurpitsa.
Valmista taatelikastike kuten edellisessä ohjeessa ja lisää sinappi.
Kaada kastike kanan ja kurpitsan päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
To the above described dressing add mustard, pour over [1] and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] G.-V. Perfundes; Tor. piper fundes. The pumpkin, not mentioned here, is likewise served cold boiled, seasoned with the same dressing. It is perhaps used for stuffing the chicken and cooked simultaneously with the same.

recipes.title: Kana täytettynä tarolla ja oliiveilla
recipes.originalTitle: Chicken and dasheens (PULLUM ELIXUM CUM COLOCASIIS ELIXIS)
recipes.description: Kana täytetään kuoritulla tarolla tai perunalla ja vihreillä oliiveilla, keitetään varovasti ja tarjotaan taatelikastikkeen kanssa.
ingredients: 300 g taroa tai perunaa kuorittuna ja kuutioina
instructions: Täytä kana taroilla ja oliiveilla väljästi, jotta täyte mahtuu turpoamaan, ja sulje aukko.
Keitä kana varovasti hiljaisella liemellä, ettei se halkea.
Tarjoa taatelikastikkeen kanssa (survo mausteet, taatelit, etikka, hunaja, kalakastike ja öljy).
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
The above sauce is also used for this dish. Stuff the chicken with [peeled] dasheens and [stoned] green olives, though not too much so that the dressing may have room for expansion, to prevent bursting while the chicken is being cooked in the pot. Hold it down with a small basket, lift it up frequently [2] and handle carefully so that the chicken does not burst [3].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Dasheens are the equivalent of the ancient colocasium; at least they are very close relatives. Cf. Notes to {Rx} Nos. 74, 216, 244, 322. [2] For inspection. G.-V. levas; Tor. lavabis, for which there is no reason. [3] Dann. and Goll., not knowing the colocasium or dasheen have entirely erroneous versions of this formula. The dasheen is well adapted for the stuffing of fowl. Ordinarily the dasheen is boiled or steamed, mashed, seasoned and then stuffed inside of a raw chicken which is then roasted. Being very starchy, the dasheen readily absorbs the fats and juices of the roast, making a delicious dressing, akin in taste to a combined potato and chestnut purée. As the above chicken is cooked in bouillon or water, the dasheen may be used in a raw state for filling. We have tried this method. Instead of confining the chicken in a basket, we have tied it in a napkin and boiled slowly until done. Serve cold, with the above dressing.

recipes.title: Varuksen kana valkoisessa pähkinäkastikkeessa
recipes.description: Kana keitetään liemessä, öljyssä ja viinissä purjon, korianterin ja kyntelin kanssa; kastike pähkinöistä, maidosta ja liemestä, sidottuna valkuaisilla.
instructions: Keitä kana kalakastikkeessa, öljyssä, viinissä ja vedessä yrttinippujen kanssa. Poista nipun.
Survo pippuri ja pähkinät veden ja kanaliemen kanssa, lisää maito.
Lisää seos kanan kanssa pataan ja keitä yhdessä. Sido kastike vatkatuilla valkuaisilla ja kaada kanan päälle.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Cook the chicken in this stock: broth, oil, wine, a bunch of leeks, coriander, satury; when done, crush pepper, nuts with 2 glasses of water [2] and the juice of the chicken. Retire the bunches of greens, add milk to taste. The things crushed in the mortar add to the chicken and cook it together: thicken the sauce with beaten whites of egg [3] and pour the sauce over the chicken. This is called "white sauce."

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] G.-V. Vardanus; Tor. Vardamus; Hum. Vardanus legendum, puto, Varianus, portentuosæ luxuriæ Imperator. Hum. thinks the dish is dedicated to emperor Varianus (?) The word may also be the adjective of Varus, Quintilius V., commander of colonial armies and glutton, under Augustus. Varus committed suicide after his defeat in the Teutoburg Forest by the Germans. [2] G.-V. broth, own stock--ius de suo sibi. [3] Strain, avoid ebullition after the eggs have been added. Most unusual liaison; usually the yolks are used for this purpose. The whites are consistent with the name of the sauce.

recipes.title: Frontoksen tillikana
recipes.description: Puolikypsä kana haudutetaan garumissa ja öljyssä tillin, purjon, kyntelin ja korianterin kanssa; päälle rypälesiirapilla värjättyä kastiketta ja pippuria.
instructions: Ruskista kana kevyesti ja laita pataan kalakastikkeen, öljyn, veden ja yrttien kanssa.
Hauduta kypsäksi. Nosta kana vadille.
Värjää liemi siirapilla, kaada kanan päälle ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
A half-cooked chicken marinaded in a pickle of broth, mixed with oil, to which is added a bunch of dill, leeks, satury and green coriander. Finish it in this broth. When done, take the chicken out [2] dress it nicely on a dish, pour over the [sauce, colored with] reduced must, sprinkle with pepper and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Named for a Roman by the name of Fronto. There is a sucking pig à la Fronto, too. Cf. {Rx} No. 374. M. Cornelius Fronto was orator and author during the reign of Emperor Hadrian. According to Dann. a certain Frontone under Emperor Severus. [2] List., G.-V. levabis; Tor. lavabis, for which there is little or no occasion. He may mean to clean, i.e. remove skin, tissues, sinews, small bones, etc.

recipes.title: Kana maito-leipäkastikkeessa
recipes.description: Kana keitetään liemessä, öljyssä ja viinissä korianterin ja sipulin kanssa; liemeen lisätään maito, hunaja ja murennettu ohut leipä, ja päälle oregano-pippurikastike.
instructions: Keitä kana kalakastikkeessa, öljyssä, viinissä ja vedessä korianterin ja sipulien kanssa. Nosta pois.
Siivilöi liemi uuteen kattilaan, lisää maito, suola ja hunaja ja hauduta.
Murenna leipä vähitellen joukkoon sekoittaen. Lisää kana kokonaisena tai paloina.
Annostele syvään vatiin ja valele kastikkeella, jossa survottua pippuria, lipstikkaa, oreganoa ja hunajaa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Cook the chicken [as follows, in] broth, oil, with wine added, to which add a bunch of coriander and [green] onions. When done take it out [3] [strain and save] the broth, and put it in a new sauce pan, add milk and a little salt, honey and a pint [4] of water, that is, a third part: place it back on a slow fire to simmer. Finally break [the paste, [1]] put it little by little into [the boiling broth] stirring well so it will not burn. Put the chicken in, either whole or in pieces [5] dish it out in a deep dish. This cover with the following sauce [6] pepper, lovage, origany, moistened with honey and a little reduced must. Add some of the [chicken] broth, heat in a small sauce pan and when it boils thicken with roux [7] and serve.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Spätzle, noodles, macaroni; this dish is the ancient "Chicken Tetrazzini." Dann. Chicken pie or patty. [2] tractum and gala, prepared with paste and milk. Cf. tractomelitus, from tractum and meli, paste and honey. [3] Cf. Note 2 to {Rx} Nos. 244 and 246. [4] List. minimum; Tor. heminam; Sch. eminam. See Measures. The noodle paste should be cooked separately in the water. [5] List. vel carptum, which is correct. Tor. vel careotam, out of place here. [6] This sauce seems to be superfluous. Very likely it is a separate formula for a sauce of some kind. [7] Seems superfluous, too. The noodle paste in the chicken gravy makes it sufficiently thick.

recipes.title: Täytetty kana speltillä ja pähkinöillä
recipes.description: Kana täytetään pippurilla, lipstikalla ja inkiväärillä maustetulla seoksella lihasta, keitetystä speltistä, aivoista, munista ja runsaista pähkinöistä.
ingredients: 100 g keitettyjä aivoja tai lisää jauhelihaa
instructions: Sekoita täytteen aineet tiiviiksi täytteeksi.
Täytä kana väljästi, jotta täyte mahtuu paisumaan, ja sulje aukko.
Paahda tai keitä kana kypsäksi, noin 1,5 tuntia.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Empty the chicken through the aperture of the neck so that none of the entrails remain. Crush pepper, lovage, ginger, cut meat [2] cooked spelt, besides crush brains cooked in the [chicken] broth, break eggs and mix all together in order to make a solid dressing; add broth to taste and a little oil, whole pepper, plenty of nuts. With this dressing stuff either a chicken or a suckling pig, leaving enough room for expansion [3].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Tor. fusilis. [2] Preferably raw pork or veal. [3] A most sumptuous dressing; it compares favorably with our popular stale bread pap usually called "chicken dressing."

recipes.title: Luuton täytetty kapuuni
recipes.originalTitle: Stuffed capon likewise (SIMILITER IN CAPO FACIES)
recipes.description: Kapuuni täytetään kuten edellinen kana, mutta kaikki luut poistetaan ennen kypsennystä.
instructions: Sekoita täyte.
Täytä luutettu lintu, kääri muotoonsa ja sido.
Paahda 175 asteessa noin 1,5–2 tuntia.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
The capon is stuffed in a similar way but is cooked with all the bones removed [2].

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] Sch. in capso. May be interpreted thus: Cooked in an envelope of caul or linen, in which case it would correspond to our modern galantine of chicken. [2] Tor. ossibus eiectis; Hum. omnibus e.; i.e. all the entrails, etc., which is not correct. The bones must be removed from the capon in this case.

recipes.title: Kana espanjalaisessa oliiviöljyssä
recipes.description: Kana haudutetaan vedessä ja runsaassa oliiviöljyssä, kunnes neste on haihtunut, ja nostetaan öljystä; päälle pippuria.
instructions: Laita kana pataan veden, öljyn ja suolan kanssa.
Kypsennä, kunnes neste on haihtunut ja kana paistuu öljyssä.
Nosta kana pois niin, että öljy jää pataan, ja ripottele pippuria.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Take a chicken and prepare it as above. Empty it through the aperture of the neck so that none of the entrails remain. Take [a little] water [3] and plenty of spanish oil, stir, cook together until all moisture is evaporated [4] when this is done take the chicken out, so that the greatest possible amount of oil remains behind [5] sprinkle with pepper and serve [6].

[explicit] trophetes apicii. Liber sextus [tac.]

tidiness differs from contemporary Dutch kitchens and the clothing of the cooks reminds one of Henry VIII, who issued at Eltham in 1526 this order: "... provide and sufficiently furnish the kitchens of such scolyons as shall not goe naked or in garments of such vilenesse as they doe ... nor lie in the nights and dayes in the kitchens ... by the fire-side...."--MS. No. 642, Harleian Library.}

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] The ancient version of Chicken à la Maryland, Wiener Backhähndl, etc. [2] Tor. Leocozymus; from the Greek leucozomos, prepared with white sauce. The formula for the cream sauce is lacking here. Cf. {Rx} No. 245. [3] The use of water to clarify the oil which is to serve as a deep frying fat is an ingenious idea, little practised today. It surely saves the fat or oil, prevents premature burning or blackening by frequent use, and gives a better tasting friture. The above recipe is a mere fragment, but even this reveals the extraordinary knowledge of culinary principles of Apicius who reveals himself to us as a master of well-understood principles of good cookery that are so often ignored today. Cf. Note 5 to {Rx} No. 497. [4] The recipe fails to state that the chicken must be breaded, or that the pieces of chicken be turned in flour, etc., and fried in the oil. [5] Another vital rule of deep fat frying not stated, or rather stated in the language of the kitchen, namely that the chicken must be crisp, dry, that is, not saturated with oil, which of course every good fry cook knows. [6] With the cream sauce, prepared separately, spread on the platter, with the fried chicken inside, or the sauce in a separate dish, we have here a very close resemblance to a very popular modern dish. (Schuch and Danneil insert here Excerpta XXIX, XXX and XXXI.)

recipes.title: Porsaankylki asafetida-etikkakastikkeessa
recipes.description: Alkuperäisessä emakon kohtua ja utaretta; nykyään porsaankylki, maustettuna asafetidalla, etikalla ja garumilla.
instructions: Keitä porsaankylki suolavedessä kypsäksi ja viipaloi.
Sekoita asafetida, etikka ja kalakastike ja tarjoa lihan kanssa.
recipes.author: Apicius; engl. J. D. Vehling (1936)
recipes.originalText:
Sterile sow's womb (also udder and belly) is prepared in this manner: take [2] laser from cyrene or parthia, vinegar and broth.

Selityksiä (Pegge 1780):

[1] The vulva of a sow was a favorite dish with the ancients, considered a great delicacy. Sows were slaughtered before they had a litter, or were spayed for the purpose of obtaining the sterile womb. [2] Tor. sentence wanting in other texts.
